_comment: U11 item 6: gradually-typed benchmark suite. Each entry is one benchmark; `steps` is ordered strictly by annotation coverage, each step a genuine superset of annotations over the previous step, same program logic and observable output. `path` is repo-root-relative. An optional `explained` string on a step documents a known, principled reason that step may be slower than the one before it, suppressing scripts/gradual-benchmark.sh's hard failure for that specific step while the measured number is still printed. Read with scripts/gradual-benchmark.sh.

steps.label: 0% (.sol, no annotations)
steps.explained: Measured ~13% slower than the .lua step, not a cost of annotation coverage (both steps have 0% coverage). function_calls.lua declares `work` as `local function work(x)` (Lua idiom - resolves via a direct upvalue/register read, crate/sol/src/lua_bytecode/compile_calls.rs's Resolved::Local/Upval, executed by lua_runtime/dispatch/bytecode.rs's GetUpval/Move). This step instead declares a top-level `function work(x)` (matching ../function_calls.sol's own existing convention, kept so only annotations vary across these steps) - that compiles to SetGlobal/GetGlobal (compile_stmt.rs's GlobalFunction path), and every one of the 10,000,000 calls in the hot loop pays an extra _ENV-table probe (inline-cached per pc via Proto::global_cache, but still a table-vs-non-table check + ObjectId guard + possible string-key intern on a miss - lua_runtime/dispatch/bytecode.rs:309-430, lua_runtime/ic.rs) instead of a zero-overhead local/upvalue read. Isolated A/B (hyperfine, --warmup 1 --min-runs 5, same binary): lua/local-fn 16.437s vs sol/local-fn 17.364s (the base sol-dynamic-interpreter-vs-reference-Lua gap) vs sol/global-fn 18.183s (+4.7% more on top, attributable specifically to the global-vs-local dispatch difference) - consistent with the ~13% full-step delta.
